caption: The video captures a woman with long dark hair, wearing a yellow-and-gold sequined belly-dance costume of a halter top and a layered skirt over gold trousers, standing back to the camera before a large mirror in a bright studio. Her smiling reflection in the glass confirms the mirrored figure is the same dancer. Her arms travel through a continuous sequence, rising near her head and then folding into a cross in front of her chest. As they open and stretch wide to the sides, her hips sway and the yellow skirt flares laterally. She bends one arm to frame her head while the other hand rests on her hip, pausing in this shape. The arms then sweep forward and cross once more before swinging wide again. One arm lifts high overhead as the body shifts weight in place. The motion settles into a sustained pose with her right hand held at her forehead and her left on her hip. Throughout, the white walls, ceiling air-conditioner, track lights and mirror seams remain still, marking the camera stationary while the routine continues past the edge.
